subject: Execution
notes: kb/Work PB64 T1 (2026-08-19): a SORT/MERGE COLLATING SEQUENCE alphabet associated with a locale uses that locale's LC_COLLATE, SNAPSHOTTED when the statement begins (CobolSort.Init takes the sequence; LocaleCollation.Snapshot binds the current-locale form to the locale current then) — a SET LOCALE in the INPUT PROCEDURE has no effect on the sort phase.
